capabilities: Render interactive heatmap graphs of daily note or task counts
Track habits and notes with color-coded cells per day
Customize graph types, cell colors, emojis, and date ranges
Configure cell click and hover interactions with statistics
Integrate with DataviewJS to dynamically render charts
disambiguation: Not the note-link Graph view; it renders GitHub-style activity heatmaps.
extras: A Chinese documentation version is available; usage guides for API/codeblock usage are listed as links rather than explained in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize daily activity counts (notes created, tasks done) as a heatmap over a date range.

relations.evidence: Integrate with DataviewJS, use contribution graph's api to dynamically render charts

summary: Heatmap plugin that renders interactive GitHub-style contribution graphs tracking daily notes, tasks, and other activity in your vault.
